ModMetaData.name: Turrets For All Post-Medieval Tech Levels
ModMetaData.author: Bambaryla, Haderoth, Samael Gray
ModMetaData.description:
Fourth installment in the All-Bamba series, turrets for all electrical tech levels. Included turrets are: - Industrial machine gun turret - Industrial rocket turret - Industrial artillery - Industrial EMP machine gun - Spacer machine gun turret - Spacer rocket turret - Spacer artillery - Spacer EMP machine gun - Spacer Anti-Air Turret (CE) - Ultra machine gun turret - Ultra rocket turret - Ultra artillery - Ultra EMP machine gun
Fully compatible with Combat Extended and Muzzle Flash!
Credits: - Bambaryla - general design - Haderoth - artwork - Samael Gray - mod structure, Muzzle Flash integration, CE compatibility
Inspirations: - some turret designs are inspired by real-world military hardware - some turret designs are inspired by Tanki game - most spacer turrets are heavily inspired by Helldivers 2
